text:
maria: Quick heads-up — our per-model burn in eu-west-1 spiked ~3.2x over the last 6h. Poking the FinOps tiles now, looks like a single model-route is responsible. Anyone else seeing routing changes?

raj: Yup, saw that too. Billing ETL shows 24h spend jump 12k -> 38k for EU region. Ran a top-n by model earlier; top contributor is `redwood-large-v2-quant` (looks like hosted->dedicated fallback traffic).

olivia: That's the variant we flipped for latency yesterday. We pinned the canary to Dedicated because it failed hosted fallback during load tests. Did the routing policy accidentally widen?

kevin: I ran a quick query:
```sql
SELECT model, route, SUM(cost) AS cost
FROM finops.billing
WHERE region = 'eu-west-1' AND timestamp >= '2026-03-16'
GROUP BY model, route
ORDER BY cost DESC
LIMIT 20;
```
Linking dashboard: https://redwood.internal/finops/dashboards/model-route-burn
Also seeing `reserved_utilization` for EU dedicated pool around 42% for the window.

maria: If reserved util is low but cost is high, my first guess is on-demand fallbacks or cross-region egress. Can someone check instance types and whether preemptible/spot usage changed? Also noticed some requests lack proper `billing_tag` on submitter side.

jen: Checked cluster provisioning logs — several jobs accidentally launched `n1-standard-16` (legacy mapping) instead of the expected `a100-v4` nodes because autoscaler mapping fell back during the roll. Logs: `2026-03-16T18:12:03Z provisioner=fleet autoscaler=info action=fallback_to_default_instance`.

raj: That autoscaler PR was reverted but the rollout window aligns with the spike. Also seeing unusual cross-zone network transfers between eu-west-1a and eu-west-1c — rough egress estimate from network logs: ~$6.1k of the delta.

olivia: Ok — action plan suggestion: 1) pause the canary 2) revert routing rule for `redwood-large-v2-quant` 3) run detailed per-request cost-query to isolate egress vs instance compute 4) open cloud support ticket for possible rebate on egress.

maria: Agree. I'll open the cloud ticket and the internal incident. Also want a FinOps tile request: hourly per-model per-route burn with reserved_utilization overlay so we can see these spikes next time. Who can sketch the query?

kevin: I'll draft the query and add the tile tonight. Quick ask for finance team: what's our current committed capacity for EU Dedicated (USD/year) and utilization headroom? Need that to decide reserved vs on-demand conversion.

finance-bot: Current EU Dedicated commitment: $1,800,000/year. Last 30d utilization estimate: 62%. Commit dashboard: https://redwood.internal/finops/commits/eu

maria: Thanks — opened ticket FIN-4321 and linked cloud support case. Assigning owners: @kevin @jen @raj @olivia. Triage call tomorrow 10:00 UTC.

jen: Adding runbook changes: autoscaler rollback steps, instance-tagging checklist, and a new alert: "per-model hourly cost delta > 150%" to page oncall.

raj: I'll run a one-off retroactive tagging job to correctly attribute instances to teams/routes so we can reconcile billing.

olivia: For ML: we'll revert canary to `redwood-large-v1` until quantization perf is validated. Will also add a preflight to check routing rules before rollouts. :thumbsup:

maria: Good. I'll update FIN ticket with next steps and capture the dashboard tile request. Thanks everyone, we'll follow up after the triage call.
